description: Runtime knobs. Edit freely; the routine reads these on every run.

signal_window.note: Signals are generated only within this window. Outside these hours the routine should post a note and exit.

macro_kill_switches.note: If live VIX is at or above vix_max, post kill-switch message and stop. No signals regardless of confluence.

confluence.note: min_categories_for_buy=4 for with-trend setups. Raise to 5 for counter-trend (weekly bear + daily bull). max_signals_per_run caps concurrent open signals.

risk.note: Stop = entry - (stop_atr_multiple * ATR14). Target = entry + (target_atr_multiple * ATR14). R:R must be >= min_rr or the signal is downgraded to WAIT.

earnings.note: Exclude ticker for blackout_trading_days_before days before earnings and blackout_trading_days_after day after. First eligible day post-blackout requires post_earnings_raised_bar confluence.

vix_regime.note: Shapes position-sizing notes in the Slack message. Above elevated_max the macro kill-switch fires.

volume.note: Volume as % of 20-day average. Below neutral_pct on a breakout day = automatic non-confirm.
